title: The Day America Got Noon Twice
aria: Animated short about 18 November 1883, when North American railroads introduced standard time zones and one man in New York stopped the master clock for 3 minutes 58 seconds, so that some places had noon twice
foot: Narration is an AI voice (Kokoro, af_heart). Music and effects: original score with CC0 samples (VSCO 2 Community Edition, Kenney). Events follow the New York Times (Nov. 1883), the Library of Congress Law Library, TIME (2019), Bartky, Selling the True Time (2000), and Gordon, American Heritage (2001); faces, rooms and staging are illustration. Not affiliated with any railroad or telegraph company.
